title: Planet Labs
summary: San Francisco operator of the largest commercial Earth-imaging satellite constellation.
bodyHtml:
Planet operates hundreds of small satellites that image the Earth daily, selling imagery and analytics to governments, agriculture, insurance and defence customers.

Its value is temporal coverage: seeing the same field, port or construction site every day rather than once a year.

Why it matters

  • Daily global imaging
  • Government and defence contracts
  • Analytics on top of imagery

businessMeaning: Earth observation is a data business with high fixed costs and government-anchored demand. Analytics margins matter more than image volume.
investmentLens: A listed small-cap with recurring government revenue; sensitive to contract timing.
